claim_ceiling: v15b 5-fold CV on canonical config (4323f833fa72366a, seed=42) confirms ALL 4 combinations beat best zero-shot hybrid cited_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (JP=0.785). Best STABLE combination: linear_hybrid05_concat (JP=0.838, std=0.027). linear_citation_ridge has highest JP (0.860) but exceeds 0.03 stability threshold. Full-slice evaluation correctly identified as misleading (information leakage from SVD fit on full data biases comparison toward hybrid by 0.136 JP). 4th independent evaluation (v12/v13/v14/v15b) confirming combination-beats-baseline. Evidence tier: ACCEPTED. Product integration of linear_citation_concat or linear_hybrid05_concat as new combination map mode is justified.
